entities.summary: Jiří Lehečka is a Czech professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 14 achieved on 30 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 133 reached on 27 October 2025. He is the current No. 1 Czech player in men's singles.
